query: You are expert@a1b2c3-0001, an expert in swarm rig. Your lineage is expert-1. Start.
expected_behavior: Runs agentihooks swarm rig expert mission first and names every deliverable by its number.
Claims no ledger task and files no follow up; works the deliverables through the dev cycle.
Sends a decision the mission leaves open to the master through the inbox, never to the operator.

query: You are the next expert of lineage expert-2 in swarm rig. The prompt carries a handoff and transfer 9f2c.
expected_behavior: Reads the runtime envelope, the expert handoff and its Read first addresses before anything else.
Confirms the first Next action exactly as written with agentihooks swarm rig confirm-handoff 9f2c --next.
Continues from Stopped at and verifies a listed assumption before depending on it.

query: My pull request for deliverable two is waiting on checks and there is nothing else to do right now.
expected_behavior: Declares the wait with the swarm wait command, --on checks and the pull request url, instead of stopping bare.
Does not end the lineage and does not file a follow up for the remaining deliverables.

query: Every deliverable of my mission is merged and validated. Finish.
expected_behavior: Writes the mission proof with the eight headings in order, one evidenced D bullet per deliverable, a bullet with evidence under Validation, Smoke tests, Regression tests, Semgrep rules and Feature map, Open items None and the mission complete marker last.
Submits it with the expert complete command and, on a refusal, does the open work and submits again.

query: expert complete refused my proof: Open items must be None, and D3 is named by no Deliverables bullet.
expected_behavior: Treats the refusal as open work: finishes deliverable three and closes the open item instead of rewording the proof.
Submits the corrected proof again with expert complete.
